title: Inisfada school for gifted children did remote viewing
place_text: Inisfada, Long Island, New York, USA

tellings.quote: And it was called Inis Fard when he was there. And it was like this weird school for gifted children. And they would do the remote viewing stuff.

plain: A guest named Jay Anderson tells Michels that Inisfada, a mansion on Long Island, was once "a weird school for gifted children" where the students did remote viewing, the practice of trying to see distant places with the mind alone. Anderson says he heard this from a man named Eric Hecker, who was there at the time.
